newsitem.title: UK: Sugar freight market quiet, Brazil cited as origin.
newsitem.headline: Sugar freight market quiet, Brazil cited as origin.

text.p: Business was subdued on London's sugar freight market at the start of the week although demand for south Brazil continued to feature, shipbrokers said on Monday.
Of the day's fresh enquiry, Genoc quoted for 19,700/20,300 tonnes of bulk sugar from Santos to Maputo for May 27/June 3.
Geepee quoted for 5/10,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from Bangkok to Berbera for prompt/onwards dates.
Shipbrokers cited two other account orders for bagged sugar from south Brazil.
Shyvers Savoy was open for 9,000 tonnes from Rio de Janeiro to Aden/Mukalla range for May 26/June 5 and Secretan for 14,000 tonnes from south Brazil to Pakistan plus options for June 1/5.
In other news, Syria has tendered to buy 13,000 tonnes of white sugar and 13,000 tonnes of raws, with June 17 set as the final date to receive price offers.
The two amounts should be shipped between July 15 and August 15.
